# gridfm-trustlayer

> Conformal trustworthiness layer for power-system models: calibrated prediction intervals (stratified split-conformal and kernel-weighted conformal prediction) and screening of contingencies against operating limits. A command-line tool reads GridFM's file layout; a Python API works with the predictions of any model.

To use trustlayer with your own model and data, read the guide first. After `pip install gridfm-trustlayer`, `gridfm_trustlayer guide` prints the version that matches the installation.

## Guides

- [Using trustlayer with your own data](https://gridfm.github.io/gridfm-trustlayer/user-guide/own-data/): a long table of predictions and true values, `ChannelSet.from_frame`, `check_inputs`, fitting, checking coverage, mistakes to avoid
- [Python API](https://gridfm.github.io/gridfm-trustlayer/user-guide/python-api/): the calibrators on NumPy arrays, screening statuses, artifacts, bandwidth tuning
- [Kernel-weighted calibration](https://gridfm.github.io/gridfm-trustlayer/user-guide/kernel/): embeddings, bandwidth, tuning, diagnostics
- [Quick start](https://gridfm.github.io/gridfm-trustlayer/getting-started/quickstart/): the command-line workflow with GridFM data
